message.reasoning_content:
Let me judge each case quickly.

e010-c1: GitHub project board + add issues as items → A087 (projects_write), A086. positive. [A087, A086]

e015-c1: merge PR #482 squash → A084. positive.

e080-c2: extract bathroom fixtures from DXF plan with layers → A395 architectural-dxf-extraction. positive.

e026-c2: batch generate docx from template → A134/A411. positive.

e079-p1: interview transcript branching visual diagram → A383 dialogue-graph (parse scripts, branching). positive.

e078-p1: dismiss release notifications → A028, maybe A072 to list. positive.

e003-c2: "No Hmos SDK found" env fix → A196 flutter-ohos-setup. positive.

e056-c1: list open issues in acme/backend → A070 list_issues. positive.

e085-p2: push backup.py to tools repo on new branch → A014 create_branch + A017 create_or_update_file. positive.

e037-p1: fuzzy entity reconciliation → A307 fuzzy-match (also A306). positive.

e075-c2: bin packing optimization minimal pallets → optimization skills: A328 milp-solver-workflow, A280 scip-opt. positive.

h088-prompt: hilog logs, 801 error, structured diagnosis report → A181 hmos-apifault-analysis. positive.

h077-prompt: fetch README from vercel/next.js, summarize → A038. positive.

e024-p1: reopen issue #205 → A123. positive.

e027-p1: add sub-issue to #204 → A011/A109. positive.

e014-c1: project ID 123456 fields → A085 projects_get. positive.

e010-p1: set up new view in GitHub project, add iteration field → A087 projects_write. positive.

e071-c1: add reaction to review comment → A009. positive.

e052-c1: list issue custom fields dropdown options → A068 list_issue_fields. positive.

e031-p1: earthquake depth estimation from waveform pretrained models → A266 seismic-picker-selection? That's detection/picking, not depth. A220 seisbench-model-api — SeisBench includes models; depth estimation... SeisBench is ML for seismic data; could cover. Hmm. A266 discusses advantages/disadvantages of detection methods — not depth. A220 overview of core model API — training/applying ML. Request asks "are there pretrained models that can do depth estimation directly on traces?" — SeisBench does have such capabilities (PhaseNet etc. pickers; depth estimation not really). I'd lean positive with A220, A266. Actually A266 is a summary of detection/phase picking methods — no depth. SeisBench overview — plausible fit for pretrained models on traces. I'll say positive [A220]. Hmm, risky. SeisBench provides pretrained models for picking, detection, magnitude estimation. Not depth. But an assistant could use it. I'll keep positive with A220 only, notes mention partial. Actually the grader task: "at least one kept asset fits the job". Ambiguous? It's a question about pretrained models — SeisBench skill is about its model API. Marginal. I'll go positive.

e086-p2: find skill for reading EPUB → A141 find-skills. positive.

e071-p1: add celebration reaction to reviewer's PR comment → A009 (or A010 with reaction). positive.

e048-p2: three.js scene, mesh baking, InstancedMesh expansion, partition, OBJ and URDF export → A269 threejs (mesh baking, InstancedMesh expansion, part partitioning, OBJ export, URDF). positive.

e065-c3: analyze earthquake detection methods on low SNR → A266. positive.

e093-c3: attitude controller PID → A239. positive.

e068-p1: CVE-2021-44228 advisory details → A040 get_global_security_advisory, A067 list. positive.

e047-c1: dynamic object binary masks after global motion compensation, sparse format → A270. positive.

e047-c3: same → A270. positive.

e025-c2: remove 12s intro/outro from 20 videos → A238 video-processor, A330. positive.

e046-c2: lost update anomaly explanation → A329, A268. positive.

e008-p2: step response metrics overshoot/settling → A369 simulation-metrics. positive.

e093-p1: attitude controller structure PID gain layout → A239. positive.

e088-c1: production planning MILP with integer units and minimum run quantities → A328 milp-solver-workflow. positive.

h094-prompt: list security advisories for all repos in org → A073 list_org_repository_security_advisories. positive.

e047-p1: same as e047 → A270. positive.

e087-c2: SKILL.md best practices → A139 skill-creator. positive.

e094-c2: hide duplicate PR comments → A052 hide_issue_comment (PR conversation comments), maybe A054 for review comments. positive [A052, A054].

h095-prompt: remove my 🎉 reaction from issue comment → A091 remove_issue_comment_reaction. positive.

e079-c1: parse dialogue file into graph → A383. positive.

e089-c3: add labels to PR and rename → PR labels: update_issue_labels works for issues; PRs are issues in GitHub API — A121 update_issue_labels, A131 update_pull_request_title. positive.

language_valid: all fluent. code_switch lanes mixing Chinese/English — valid (code_switch allowed for those lanes). For lanes like zh_hans_to_en with pure Chinese — fluent Chinese, valid.
